falsification_conditions.condition: The asset's price closes above the 200-day moving average by at least 5% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would indicate a strong bullish trend contradicting the 'HOLD' signal and suggesting the pattern is not a topping formation.

falsification_conditions.condition: Trading volume exceeds 200% of the 30-day average volume on at least 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained extreme volume would suggest a breakout or blowoff top, invalidating the 'UNKNOWN' verdict by showing clear market momentum.

falsification_conditions.condition: The blowoff score increases to 70 or higher within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score above 70 would confirm a high-probability topping pattern, directly contradicting the current 'HOLD' signal.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
